reason: A DSH web Settings panel for searching, inspecting, and runtime-starting or stopping loaded plugins, with core-plugin safeguards and local toggle history.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中提供插件开关面板，用于搜索、查看状态并在运行时启停非核心插件。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH Web Settings panel for searching, inspecting, and starting or stopping non-core plugins at runtime.

capabilities: Displays a Settings panel listing loaded plugins and their runtime states
Enables or disables non-core plugins at runtime
Provides same-origin HTTP endpoints for listing plugins, reading toggle history, and changing runtime state
Persists the last 1000 toggle records to a local JSONL file
